controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:19.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:19.500Z"
| WHERE host.name == "web-1"
| STATS count = COUNT(*)
        BY data_stream.dataset
| SORT count DESC
